update.title: Added artifact staging and curation to Work Reports
update.summary: Work Report now gathers captured evidence into a staging pool where it can be scored, captioned, approved, or rejected before the approved set is copied into report-owned storage.

blocks.body:
## Stage evidence before attachment

Work Report now gathers discovered evidence in a PostgreSQL staging pool instead of attaching every nearby file immediately. Each candidate enters as pending with its source path, artifact type, metadata, and an optional link to the shared artifact record.

Files can also be added directly, so discovered and explicitly supplied material move through the same curation flow.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Source[Discover or add] --> Pending[Pending]
  Pending -.-> Score[Optional score]
  Pending --> Curate{Curate}
  Score -.-> Curate
  Curate -->|Approve| Store[Store in report]
  Curate -->|Reject| Exclude[Exclude]
  Store --> Complete[Complete]
blocks.description: Candidates remain separate from the report until curation selects the approved set for durable storage.

blocks.body:
## Curate the candidate set

Staged artifacts can be captioned and approved or rejected by item, filename pattern, or as a group. An optional local model can add a relevance score and short explanation, and threshold commands can apply those scores across pending items.

Finalizing an approved set copies that material into the report’s durable storage, writes the artifact list, completes the report, and clears the staging pool.
